name: Space Trader
description: The Palm OS classic, played in the chat window, from a panel with the ship's bars, a star chart you press to jump, and a market dealt as a hand of cards — one commodity each, with what it costs here, where in range pays more and what the difference comes to a cargo bay. Trade between 140 star systems, and fight off the pirates who stop you on the way, a round at a time. You make every move; the model reads the position each turn and advises, and never spends your credits or fires your guns itself.
author: alexbeatnik
